info.name: Nextcloud Migrate
info.summary: Migrate files, account data, contacts, calendars, and shares 1:1 to a remote Nextcloud instance
info.description: Admin-driven tool to push a user's files and folder structure to a remote Nextcloud instance over WebDAV. Supports dry-run analysis, resumable background transfer, and per-file verification. Optionally also migrates each mapped user's core account profile (displayname, email, quota, language, group memberships) via the OCS Provisioning API, each mapped user's own address books/contacts via CardDAV, each mapped user's own calendars via CalDAV, and each mapped user's own shares (once their files have finished transferring) via the OCS Share API.
info.author: Nextcloud Migrate Contributors
